<!--
Measured, not read: a manuscript is double spaced throughout, 24pt from one
baseline to the next at 12pt, from line to line, from paragraph to
paragraph, and around a heading and a block quotation. A paragraph's first
line starts half an inch in from the inch of margin.

typst set its double spacing at 26pt until its leading came down from 18pt
to 16pt. Before that, the space between paragraphs was Typst's own 1.2em, from
Typst 0.12 until typst-template.typ set par's spacing; nothing in the .typ
showed either. The first paragraph after a heading is preceded by a spacer
that formattypst.lua takes back by the paragraph spacing, which was a fixed
18pt and left that paragraph too close in a mode spaced otherwise.

The .pdf set a blank line above every heading, 49pt from the line before
it, because titlespacing added a \baselineskip of its own on top of the line
spacing; APA adds no space around a heading. Measured from body line to body
line across the heading, since the bold of a heading is boxed taller than
the roman of the body and reads a point or two out from a word beside it.

The words are made up so that each is found once.
-->

Alphaone alphatwo.

Betaone betatwo.

# Headone

Gammaone gammatwo.

Deltaone deltatwo.

> Quoteone words of a quotation long enough that it has to run on to several lines, so that it is a block quotation and not a line of one, quotelast.

Epsilonone epsilontwo.
